source: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart), daily close, read through the owner browser on 2026-11-15
replaces: FMP stable/historical-price-eod/non-split-adjusted (decision B1): FMP returned HTTP 429 for every request on 2026-11-15
method: last session close <= as-of; Yahoo close is split-adjusted only (not dividend-adjusted); multiplied by the product of split factors with effective date after the as-of date to recover the unadjusted close, consistent with 10-K cover share counts
caveats: Symbols delisted, acquired or renamed after the as-of date are partly missing on Yahoo: missing prices concentrate in non-survivors; this is a survivorship risk and must be reported in R12 results
Spin-offs are recorded by Yahoo as fractional splits (e.g. MMM 1.196, HON 1.0117): factor applied as Yahoo states it
Single source: not cross-checked against a second price provider

additions.method: same as above; two-step fallback (short window for the close, monthly series for split events) where the long-range request returned no rows; tickers renamed after the as-of read under the new symbol and stored under the as-of symbol (ABC>COR, ANTM>ELV, BLL>BALL, FB>META, FBHS>FBIN, FLT>CPAY, GPS>GAP, PEAK>DOC, PKI>RVTY, RE>EG, WLTW>WTW, NLOK>GEN)
